segment.source: Renders several quotations in a track that shows one at a time, with arrows to move between them, a swipe on touch and a spoken position (‘Quote 2 of 5’). Use it for: a run of customer verdicts, reviews after a conference, alumni voices on a course page, statements from every partner in a consortium. Prefer 'Quote with Portrait' when one voice is enough for the page, and 'Pull Quote' for a line taken from the article itself.
